description: An \(L(M)\)-structure \(N^*\) satisfies \(\operatorname{ElDiag}(M)\) if and only if the specific map \(a\mapsto c_a^{N^*}\) is the underlying map of an elementary embedding from \(M\) into the \(L\)-reduct of \(N^*\).
